Yukies Sweep Tigers
Today the Yukies fans broke out the brooms at Comerica Park and it worked -- <Seoul:team#403> swept the <Detroit Tigers:team#10> 4-0 and are the 2027 Major League Baseball World Series champions for the 2nd time in their history.

The Yukies derailed <Detroit:team#10> 6-3 to wrap up the title.

<Seoul:team#403> finished the season with a record of 143-19 and ranked first in the National League West Division.
